description: This file declares the CUDAHooks class which implements the at::CUDAHooksInterface for CUDA support in PyTorch. It includes functions for device management, checking CUDA capabilities, and retrieving versions of CUDA-related libraries.

classes.name: CUDAHooks
classes.description: Implementation of CUDA-specific hooks and capabilities for PyTorch, including device management and CUDA feature support checks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes CUDA hooks, likely setting up necessary CUDA environment.

methods.description: Returns the device associated with a pointer.

methods.description: Retrieves the default random generator for the specified device.

methods.description: Creates and returns a new random generator for the specified device.
